exampleHtml:
Example: Dividend calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Starting investment: $10,000
  • Monthly contribution: $500
  • Dividend yield: 3.5%
  • Annual dividend growth: 5%
  • Annual share price growth: 5%
  • Years: 20
  • Paid: Quarterly
  • Tax on dividends: 15%
  • Reinvest dividends (DRIP): Yes

The calculator returns:

  • Annual dividend income in year 20: $9,948 ($829.01 / month after tax)
  • Portfolio value: $334,392
  • Total dividends received: $76,414
  • Total contributed: $130,000
  • Yield on cost: 7.65% (Final income ÷ amount contributed)
